fields.title: 📖 A smile can be ṣadaqah
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Your smile in the face of your brother is ṣadaqah for you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Akhlāq sometimes begins with a face that does not hurt the brother.

immutable.source: 📝 Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī; Überlieferung von Abū Dharr.
